about_the_game:
Escape from a demon-infested futuristic colony!

Confined within a colossal, decaying structure—once humanity’s shield against a devastating cataclysm—three rebels stumble upon the enigmatic Exomakers: mysterious artifacts pulsing with power, capable of drawing out the heart’s essence to forge transmuted armor. Clad in formidable battle gear, they rise to confront the relentless mechanical horrors lurking within, driven to obliterate the root of evil forever!

Choose your character:

Brave: Separated from his body and confined in isolation as punishment, he excels in close-quarters combat, making him the ideal pick for beginners. His jabs are swift, powerful, and dependable, and he can materialize weapons for devastating special attacks!

Aurelia: Genetically altered into a demonic warrior for military purposes, she excels at a safer distance, calling forth Guardians to handle enemy groups. Look for chances to deal heavy damage!

?????: A highly technical character with unorthodox gameplay, capable of dominating in skilled hands.

Features:

  • Meticulously crafted pixel art graphics

  • Branching paths to explore

  • Multiple endings to uncover

  • Simple controls, dynamic gameplay: Upgrade your weapons, swap weapons for attack bonuses, and unleash special powers with perfectly timed strikes!

This game is a work in progress!

Follow Roborar Digital’s social media for updates on the game’s development!

short_description: Exobrave is a 2D action-platformer boasting a high-octane combat system. Battle through the twisting, branching paths of a futuristic colony overrun by demon-possessed automatons in a solo or co-op adventure!
